name: just_oled
description: Spectrum, VU, now playing and a clock on any I2C or SPI OLED, with the player's boot and shutdown
author: Just a Nerd

volumio_info.details: One plugin for the small OLED screens: SSD1306, SSD1309, SSD1315, SSD1305, SH1106, SH1107, SSD1327, SSD1322, SH1122, CH1120, and the colour SSD1331 and SSD1351, over I2C or SPI. An audio tap in the ALSA chain measures every source without touching the sound; the display shows a spectrum, VU bars, the track, a clock and date, and says when the player boots, restarts and shuts down.
volumio_info.changelog: 0.2.2 The ILI9341 draws the right way round (it was mirrored); verified on a 2.8 inch board. ssd1306_128x32, ssd1306_128x64 and sh1106_128x64 verified over I2C.
